dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I didn't bring it up at the time since I didn't want to cause anyone any more distress... still, the disappearance of the Fatui worries me.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: From the look on your face... I see, it appears we have similar thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Then let's stay diligent, and keep an eye out for any further developments.
